overview: Canopies that taper off instead of ending in a flat green cube, trees that now and then grow far larger than they should, and saplings that plant themselves.

1.2.0: A huge mushroom's cap no longer has a hole at each corner where its skirt turns.
An ancient one's rim is a closed ring rather than four arcs.
1.1.1: An ancient grown beside you is one you can see.
The blocks were there; a good part were never sent to your client until the chunk reloaded.
1.1.0: Huge mushrooms and the nether fungi can go ancient too, at the same odds as a tree.
A red one domed on a tall stem, a brown one spreading a plate the width of a house.
A fungus under a pagoda of wart and shroomlight.
Their caps are finished with stairs the way a canopy is.
Azalea leaves get stairs as well.
Leaves are finished with their own kind rather than a neighbour's.
1.0.0: The outermost leaves of every tree are swapped for stair-shaped leaves.
A canopy rounds off instead of stopping dead at a cube.
Grown from a sapling, laid by worldgen or drawn as part of a structure alike.
Leaf stairs decay like leaves and are walked on like stairs.
A sapling nobody picks up takes root where it lands.
